question:
A radioactive sample contains two independent nuclides $X$ and $Y$ (no decay chain). Their mean lives are

$$\tau_X=5.0\,\text{days},\qquad \tau_Y=10.0\,\text{days}.$$ 

At $t=0$, the total number of nuclei is

$$N_0=N_{X0}+N_{Y0},$$

and the initial activities satisfy

$$A_{X0}=2A_{Y0}.$$ 

(a) Find the effective half-life $T_{1/2,\,\text{eff}}$ defined as the time when the total activity becomes half of its initial value:

$$A_X(t)+A_Y(t)=\frac{1}{2}\left(A_{X0}+A_{Y0}\right).$$

(b) Find the fraction of nuclei remaining at $t=10\,\text{days}$:

$$\frac{N_X(10)+N_Y(10)}{N_0}.$$
